```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(here)
```


```{r}
pp_90            <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "pp_90_filtered.rds"))
ed_90_multiverse <- readRDS(here("Outputs", "ed_90_multiverse.rds"))

# Prepare Master Dataset
pp_90_formatted <- pp_90 %>%
  mutate(
    tp_num    = str_match(sample_file, "^t(\\d+)")[,2],
    geno_name = toupper(str_match(sample_file, "^t\\d+_([a-zA-Z]+)")[,2]),
    rep_num   = str_match(sample_file, "^t\\d+_[a-zA-Z]+(\\d+)")[,2],
    GroupingProperty = paste(tp_num, geno_name, rep_num, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-tp_num, -geno_name, -rep_num)

df_analysis <- pp_90_formatted %>%
  left_join(ed_90_multiverse, by = "GroupingProperty") %>%
  rename_with(~ "species", matches("^Species(\\.x)?$")) %>%
  rename(site = any_of(c("timepoint", "site.x", "site.y"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED50))

# Identify pure metric columns from pp_90 (Safely excludes metadata columns)
spp_pp_metrics <- setdiff(
  colnames(pp_90), 
  c("sample_file", "site", "timepoint", "genotype", "GroupingProperty", "X")
)

# Ensure only columns actually present in df_analysis are kept
spp_pp_metrics <- intersect(spp_pp_metrics, colnames(df_analysis))
# =========================================================================
# STEP 1: DEFINE GROUPING MODE & SPECIES FILTER
# =========================================================================
# CHOOSE YOUR SPECIES (or set to NULL to run across all species)
target_species <- NULL  # e.g., "AABR", "AHYA", "AGLO", "ICRA", or NULL

# CHOOSE YOUR GROUPING MODE: "K" or "ED50_Group"
grouping_mode <- "K"  # Options: "K" or "ED50_Group"

# IF grouping_mode == "K", specify cluster resolution:
k_cluster_col <- "K_3"  # e.g., "K_3", "K_6", "K_11"

# IF grouping_mode == "ED50_Group", define custom quantile/threshold cut:
# Option B1: Binary Split (High vs Low ED50 by Median)
# Option B2: Tertile Split (High, Mid, Low ED50)
ed50_split_type <- "tertile"  # Options: "binary" or "tertile"

# --- Apply Filters & Define Active Grouping Column ---
df_active <- df_analysis

if (!is.null(target_species)) {
  df_active <- df_active %>% filter(species == target_species)
}

if (grouping_mode == "K") {
  df_active <- df_active %>%
    mutate(Active_Group = as.factor(.data[[k_cluster_col]])) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Active_Group))
  
} else if (grouping_mode == "ED50_Group") {
  if (ed50_split_type == "binary") {
    med_val <- median(df_active$ED50, na.rm = TRUE)
    df_active <- df_active %>%
      mutate(Active_Group = factor(if_else(ED50 >= med_val, "High_ED50", "Low_ED50")))
  } else if (ed50_split_type == "tertile") {
    q_vals <- quantile(df_active$ED50, probs = c(0, 0.333, 0.666, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
    df_active <- df_active %>%
      mutate(Active_Group = cut(
        ED50, 
        breaks = q_vals, 
        labels = c("Low_ED50", "Mid_ED50", "High_ED50"), 
        include.lowest = TRUE
      ))
  }
}

cat("\n=========================================================\n")
cat(" Running Analysis Mode:", grouping_mode, "\n")
cat(" Active Groups Evaluated:", paste(levels(df_active$Active_Group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat(" Total Samples Included:", nrow(df_active), "\n")
cat("=========================================================\n\n")
```


```{r}
# =========================================================================
# STEP 2: Sort by Means/Medians & Measure Metric Span Across Groups
# =========================================================================
# Calculate Metric Family, Median Span (max - min), and Mean Span
metric_spans <- df_active %>%
  dplyr::select(Active_Group, all_of(spp_pp_metrics)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Active_Group, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Metric, Active_Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Group_Mean   = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Group_Median = median(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Span = max(Group_Median) - min(Group_Median),
    Mean_Span   = max(Group_Mean) - min(Group_Mean),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract Metric Family (qQuant, Sigma, Tau1, Tau2, Connect, ABQ, etc.)
    Metric_Family = str_extract(Metric, "(qQuant|Quant|mTau2|rTau1|ABQ|Connect|Sigma|NPQ|qP|qm)")
  ) %>%
  mutate(Metric_Family = if_else(is.na(Metric_Family), str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"), Metric_Family)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_Span))

# Display Top 15 broadest-shifting metrics across groups
top15_spans <- head(metric_spans, 15)
cat("--- TOP 50 METRICS BY MEAN SPAN ACROSS GROUPS ---\n")
print(top15_spans %>% dplyr::select(Metric, Metric_Family, Mean_Span, Median_Span))
```


```{r}
# =========================================================================
# STEP 3: Paired Correlation Matrix & Top Collinear Metric Clusters
# =========================================================================
# 1. Filter out zero-sd metrics
valid_metrics <- spp_pp_metrics[sapply(df_active[, spp_pp_metrics], function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)]

# 2. Compute correlation matrix
cor_mat <- cor(df_active[, valid_metrics], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

adj_mat <- abs(cor_mat) > 0.6
diag(adj_mat) <- FALSE
adj_mat[is.na(adj_mat)] <- FALSE

g_graph <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adj_mat, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
clusters_membership <- components(g_graph)$membership

collinear_clusters_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = names(clusters_membership),
  Collinear_Cluster_ID = clusters_membership
) %>%
  filter(Metric %in% top10_spans$Metric) %>%
  mutate(Metric_Family = str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"))

cat("\n--- TOP COLLINEAR TRAIT MODULES FOR SHIFTING METRICS ---\n")
print(head(collinear_clusters_df, 10))

# =========================================================================
# STEP 4: Significance Testing across Groups with FDR Correction (BH)
# =========================================================================
p_val_results <- purrr::map_dfr(top10_spans$Metric, function(trait) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(trait, "~ Active_Group"))
  fit  <- aov(form, data = df_active)
  p_val <- summary(fit)[[1]][1, "Pr(>F)"]
  
  data.frame(
    Metric        = trait,
    Metric_Family = str_extract(trait, "(qQuant|Quant|mTau2|rTau1|ABQ|Connect|Sigma|NPQ|qP|qm)"),
    ANOVA_P_Value = p_val
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Family = if_else(is.na(Metric_Family), str_extract(Metric, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+"), Metric_Family),
    P_Adj_FDR     = p.adjust(ANOVA_P_Value, method = "BH"),
    Significant   = P_Adj_FDR < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(P_Adj_FDR)

cat("\n--- FDR SIGNIFICANCE TESTING ACROSS GROUPS ---\n")
print(p_val_results)

# =========================================================================
# STEP 5: Detailed Group-Level Means Breakdown for Top Significant Traits
# =========================================================================
sig_metrics <- p_val_results %>% filter(Significant == TRUE) %>% pull(Metric)

if (length(sig_metrics) > 0) {
  group_summary_table <- df_active %>%
    dplyr::select(Active_Group, all_of(sig_metrics)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Active_Group, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
    group_by(Metric, Active_Group) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_Value = round(mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      SE_Value   = round(sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), 3),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = Active_Group, 
      values_from = c(Mean_Value, SE_Value)
    )
  
  cat("\n--- GROUP MEANS FOR SIGNIFICANT DRIVING TRAITS ---\n")
  print(group_summary_table)
}
```
